name: Blackthorn City and Hotel Appraisal
summary: Descend from the Ice Mountains into Blackthorn City, an ancient dragon sanctuary carved into rugged mountain cliffs. Stock up on Dragon Gems ($200) at the Poké Mart and consult the local Move Deleter and Move Reminder. In the cottage beside the Mart, exchange two standard Nuggets for a valuable Big Nugget. Inside the local hotel, resolve two appraisal requests: display a fully-evolved Dragon-type to the patron woman to receive XXX Attack 3, and present a powerhouse Magikarp of at least Level 65 to the hiker to earn a rare Comet Shard. Finally, grab a Max Elixir resting near the southern Dark Cave gate.

items.name: Big Nugget
items.method: Exchanged for two standard Nuggets inside the cottage next to the Poké Mart

items.name: Comet Shard
items.method: Gifted by the hiker on the hotel second floor after showing a Magikarp of at least Level 65

items.name: XXX Attack 3
items.method: Gifted by the patron woman in the hotel after showing any fully-evolved Dragon-type Pokémon

items.name: Max Elixir
items.method: Found tucked into the rocky corner near the southern Dark Cave entrance
